description: Baseline roles seeded by `npm run seed:roles`. Roles are named after the access they give, not after job titles (a Position such as "Dean" is the job; a Role such as "College Leadership" is what that job may do in the system). Permission codes come from config/permissions.json; "<resource>:*" expands to every action of that resource. The Super Admin role is managed by seed:admin and is not listed here.

roles.name: University Leadership
roles.description: Institution-wide oversight: dashboards, scorecards and final review of office reports.

roles.name: Strategy Officer
roles.description: Owns strategic planning: KPI catalog, fiscal years, contracts and reporting periods.

roles.name: Access Administrator
roles.description: Administers people, offices and role assignments without the Super Admin wildcard.

roles.name: College Leadership
roles.description: Leads a college or directorate: assigns KPIs to subordinate offices, reviews and verifies its units' performance, assigns department roles.

roles.name: Department Leadership
roles.description: Leads a department or unit: assigns KPIs to subordinate units, prepares and submits the office report.

roles.name: Staff
roles.description: Reports achievement on own targets and attaches evidence.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.description: Read-only review of KPI information, historical performance, evidence and the audit trail.
